title: Weakly associated prime ideals
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. The set $\operatorname{WeakAss}(A)$ consists of the prime ideals $\mathfrak p$ of $A$ for which some $x\in A$ has $\mathfrak p$ minimal among prime ideals containing $\operatorname{Ann}(x)=\{a\in A : ax=0\}$.
